connects_to.relationship: AWS cloud computing services for Simulations Plus cloud-based solutions

contracts.signal: Simulations Plus 10-K: in addition to its colocation facility in New York (which houses substantially all the computer hardware for its Service and Consulting solutions), Simulations Plus utilizes third-party cloud computing services from Amazon Web Services (AWS) to help support its cloud-based solutions and provide training; it relies on a single internal hosting facility and AWS to deliver certain solutions and says it cannot easily switch its AWS-serviced operations to another cloud provider.

players.product: AI-accelerated modeling and simulation software for drug development

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration (customers not named): the largest customer (Customer 1) accounted for 7% of revenue in the fiscal year ended August 31, 2025 (7% in fiscal 2024, 6% in fiscal 2023); Customer 2 and Customer 3 each accounted for 3% in fiscal 2025.

10-K fiscal 2025 (year ended August 31, 2025) segments: Software revenue $45.8M (+11.7% YoY from $41.0M), 58% of revenue, with software gross margin of 79% versus 84%; Services revenue $33.4M (+15.0% from $29.0M), 42% of revenue, with services gross margin of 30% (unchanged); total revenue $79,179 thousand, up 13%. Remaining performance obligations were $12.1 million as of August 31, 2025, 95% expected to be recognized over the next twelve months.
